/* ==========================================================================
   2TF_LOAD_I_RECONTRACT_S4_CURR_01  -  transformation flow source SQL
   Target         : 2LT_RE_CONTRACT_S4_CURR_AUD_01
   Batch control  : revised framework. Stamps rows with the batch open for
                    S4_CURR at load time. Fail-closed: with no open batch, or
                    with I_RECONTRACT not registered in the load manifest for
                    that batch, the flow stages nothing.
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------ */
SELECT
    b."BATCH_ID"                                       AS "BATCH_ID",
    b."BATCH_TYPE"                                     AS "BATCH_TYPE",
    COALESCE(o."LOAD_START_TS", b."BATCH_OPENED_TS")   AS "LOAD_TIMESTAMP",
    b."SOURCE_SYSTEM"                                  AS "SOURCE_SYSTEM",
    o."LOAD_FLOW"                                      AS "LOAD_FLOW",
    o."OBJECT_NAME"                                    AS "OBJECT_NAME",
    d."InternalRealEstateNumber",
    d."CompanyCode",
    d."RealEstateContract",
    d."REStatusObject",
    d."REInternalFinNumber",
    d."RealEstateContractOID",
    d."REContractAlternativeID",
    d."RECreationType",
    d."CreatedByUser",
    d."CreationDate",
    d."CreationTime",
    d."RESourceOfCreation",
    d."LastChangedByUser",
    d."LastChangeDate",
    d."LastChangeTime",
    d."RESourceOfChange",
    d."Responsible",
    d."REUserExclusive",
    d."REAuthorizationGroup",
    d."REContractType",
    d."ContractStartDate",
    d."ContractEndDate",
    d."REContractName",
    d."REContractActivateDate",
    d."RETenancyLaw",
    d."REContractNumberOld",
    d."REMainContractCompanyCode",
    d."REMainContract",
    d."REContractCurrency",
    d."REIndustrySector",
    d."REIsSalesRelevant",
    d."REContractDepositType",
    d."REContractSignDate",
    d."REContract2SignDate",
    d."REContractCashFlowDate",
    d."REContractFirstEndDate",
    d."REContractNoticeDate",
    d."REContractNoticeInDate",
    d."REContractNoticeReason",
    d."REContractNoticeActivationDate",
    d."RECashFlowArchivedToDate",
    d."RECashFlowLockedToDate",
    d."RECashFlowPostingFromDate",
    d."REBusinessEntity",
    d."REObjectAvailableFromDate",
    d."REObjectAvailableToDate",
    d."REHasMultipleAssignments",
    d."REPossessionStartDate",
    d."REPossessionEndDate",
    d."ValuationRelevance",
    d."RealEstateObjectType",
    d."REIdentificationKey",
    d."REBusinessPartnerRole1"
FROM "1_INBOUND_S4_CURR_D"."1LT_I_RECONTRACT_S4_CURR" AS d
CROSS JOIN "2SV_CTRL_ACTIVE_BATCH_01" AS b
JOIN "2LT_CTRL_LOAD_OBJECT_01" AS o
    ON  o."BATCH_ID"      = b."BATCH_ID"
    AND o."SOURCE_SYSTEM" = b."SOURCE_SYSTEM"
    AND o."OBJECT_NAME"   = 'I_RECONTRACT'
WHERE b."SOURCE_SYSTEM" = 'S4_CURR'
